description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/central_Dxy_dirichlet_bc. Every binding loads fixture.esm (NX=NY=4 bound at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: the compound D(D(u,x),y) replaced by the rule's makearray (doubly-interior 4-point centered cross-difference aggregate over [2,3]x[2,3]; Dirichlet odd-reflection edge strips at i=1, i=4 over j in [2,3] and j=1, j=4 over i in [2,3]; four reflected corner cells at (1,1),(1,4),(4,1),(4,4)), zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, and zero surviving metaparameter names (the free names dx, dy remain; no wall free names appear because a constant-along-wall Dirichlet value cancels in the mixed derivative). The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
